description: A tie ends the stage at the ranking, before emission. Each reading would emit a token with no tags, an error of the grammar, but the result is the tie (engine §6, §11).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision
%rule text p | q
%rule p $a(A)
%emits $a <tags($a) ∖ A>
%rule q $a(A)
%emits $a <tags($a) ∖ A>
